extraction.text:
Akash Kumar

SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER

PROFILE SUMMARY

Backend engineer and systems architect with 10+ years building high-scale, event-driven services across eCommerce, AdTech, EdTech and Manufacturing. Experienced in shipping AI infrastructure and analytics pipelines — contributing to a hosted MCP server platform with an agentic AI router and control plane, and tiered query architectures (Postgres, ClickHouse, Trino) serving millions of events per day. Strong in Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes and AWS; proven track record of turning ambiguous problems into measurable outcomes such as scaling platforms to 100M+ monthly page views and enabling analytics for 450+ brands.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Software Development Engineer Gokwik Commerce Solutions

Mar 2024 - Jul 2026

Cut orders-listing latency by designing a tiered query architecture routing reads

across Postgres (last 4h), ClickHouse (4h–30d) and Trino (>30d) to keep dashboards

responsive at multi-million-row scale.

Drove Google's OAuth sensitive-scope production approval and implemented the per-

merchant Google Analytics pipeline: ECS jobs pull GA → Kafka → Athena via Airflow

— now serving 450+ brands daily.

Built platform foundations including RBAC middleware (allowPermission), token-

scoped multi-merchant context switch with audit logging, and field-level PII encryption

with key rotation for compliance.

Designed Payment Aggregator onboarding (PayU, Easebuzz) with KYC, document

verification and state-machine lifecycle — live with 1500+ merchants.

Contributed to the hosted MCP (Model Context Protocol) server platform and central

agentic AI router; implemented control-plane features for tuning system messages,

confidence thresholds, and execution-trace visualization.

Built backend for Kwik Intent, a real-time shopper-intent classifier developed in a 24h

internal AI hackathon; owned mock profile API and intent-engine integration with a

cross-functional team.

Senior Software Engineer R Systems

Jul 2022 - Feb 2024

Owned Elink module work for the Panasonic-licensed PanaCIM MES suite, building

external data-exchange channels (PanaXML, File-XML, CSV, DB, REST) for SMT shop-

floor systems.

Translated business requirements into SDS and UTC documents; implemented, unit-

tested and drove features through regression and production rollouts.

Investigated and resolved production incidents on customer deployments and

partnered with QA on staged regression cycles.

Senior DevOps Engineer US Tech Solutions

Apr 2021 - Jul 2022

Managed multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, DigitalOcean) and CI/CD across 40+ enterprise client environments, standardizing deployment playbooks and operational practices.

Operated AWS ECS, Amplify, Jenkins and Nginx; mentored teammates on deployment hygiene, incident response and on-call rotations.

Software Developer SilverEdge Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

Sep 2019 - Apr 2021

Led migration of BetterButter from a Django monolith to Node.js microservices (User,

Event Driven Architecture

ACHIEVEMENTS

Selected Achievements

Contributed to GoKwik’s MCP platform with central agentic AI routing and control-plane tuning; built Kwik Intent intent-classifier in a 24h hackathon; designed tiered query architecture reducing dashboard latency; scaled CarToq to 100M+ monthly PVs and built push system serving 100K users/min.

EXTRA-CURRICULAR

ACTIVITIES

Technical Presentations & Hackathons

Participated in internal AI hackathons (Kwikathon) and presented engineering solutions; built rapid prototypes such as the Kwik Intent shopper-intent classifier during a 24-hour event.

Recipe, Community, Search, Video Generator) using Restify, Sequelize and Elasticsearch to support >20M visitors with improved performance.

Delivered Shopify customizations and PDP UX for Birkenstock India and implemented performance and SEO improvements for client sites.

Established GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated deploys across services.

Back End Developer Modestreet Internet Pvt. Ltd.

Feb 2019 - Sep 2019

Designed and developed e-commerce admin panel in Laravel and microservices using a custom framework; responsible for database design, CI/CD and server management for a fashion marketplace with AR features.

Software Developer Mindworks Global Media Pvt. Ltd. (CarToq.com)

Jul 2017 - Feb 2019

Single-handedly scaled CarToq to 100M+ monthly page views and 15M+ unique visitors; owned full stack, infrastructure and ad-monetisation.

Implemented AMP across the site delivering measurable load-time and revenue lift.

Built an in-house push notification system delivering to 100K users per minute and integrated 30+ advertisers with header bidding, sustaining high QPS and Redis throughput (~750K reads/sec).

Software Engineer Doyen Labs

Apr 2016 - Jul 2017

Delivered client websites and web applications across multiple stacks; owned scoping, development and client communication for custom projects.

PROJECTS

BetterButter 578 Days

Led backend team and technology planning for BetterButter, a cooking platform with

~100k recipes and videos.

Migrated the product from Django REST monolith to Node.js microservices to address QPS and scalability issues; responsible for schema redesign, DevOps and server

management.

BIRKENSTOCK 578 Days

Delivered Shopify-based OMS and storefront work for Birkenstock India; implemented PDP swatch UI in vanilla JavaScript and custom search using Shopify Liquid templates.

BIGMUSCLES NUTRITION 578 Days

Built and optimized a Shopify-based e-commerce platform with dynamic Liquid templates and performance improvements; integrated OMS services and speed

optimizations.

Modestreet Fashion 212 Days

Designed and developed e-commerce admin panel in Laravel and microservices using a custom framework; responsible for database design, CI/CD and server management

for a fashion marketplace with AR features.

Featured Customers 123 Days

Worked as Data Analyst for FeaturedCustomers.com, building capabilities for customer testimonials, case studies and related content workflows.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Software Development Engineer Gokwik Commerce Solutions
Cut orders-listing latency by designing a tiered query architecture routing reads
across Postgres (last 4h), ClickHouse (4h–30d) and Trino (>30d) to keep dashboards
responsive at multi-million-row scale.
Drove Google's OAuth sensitive-scope production approval and implemented the per-
merchant Google Analytics pipeline: ECS jobs pull GA → Kafka → Athena via Airflow
— now serving 450+ brands daily.
Built platform foundations including RBAC middleware (allowPermission), token-
scoped multi-merchant context switch with audit logging, and field-level PII encryption
with key rotation for compliance.
Designed Payment Aggregator onboarding (PayU, Easebuzz) with KYC, document
verification and state-machine lifecycle — live with 1500+ merchants.
Contributed to the hosted MCP (Model Context Protocol) server platform and central
agentic AI router; implemented control-plane features for tuning system messages,
confidence thresholds, and execution-trace visualization.
Built backend for Kwik Intent, a real-time shopper-intent classifier developed in a 24h
internal AI hackathon; owned mock profile API and intent-engine integration with a
cross-functional team.
Senior Software Engineer R Systems
Owned Elink module work for the Panasonic-licensed PanaCIM MES suite, building
external data-exchange channels (PanaXML, File-XML, CSV, DB, REST) for SMT shop-
floor systems.
Translated business requirements into SDS and UTC documents; implemented, unit-
tested and drove features through regression and production rollouts.
Investigated and resolved production incidents on customer deployments and
partnered with QA on staged regression cycles.
Senior DevOps Engineer US Tech Solutions
Managed multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, DigitalOcean) and CI/CD across 40+ enterprise client environments, standardizing deployment playbooks and operational practices.
Operated AWS ECS, Amplify, Jenkins and Nginx; mentored teammates on deployment hygiene, incident response and on-call rotations.
Software Developer SilverEdge Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Led migration of BetterButter from a Django monolith to Node.js microservices (User,
Recipe, Community, Search, Video Generator) using Restify, Sequelize and Elasticsearch to support >20M visitors with improved performance.
Delivered Shopify customizations and PDP UX for Birkenstock India and implemented performance and SEO improvements for client sites.
Established GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated deploys across services.
Back End Developer Modestreet Internet Pvt. Ltd.
Designed and developed e-commerce admin panel in Laravel and microservices using a custom framework; responsible for database design, CI/CD and server management for a fashion marketplace with AR features.
Software Developer Mindworks Global Media Pvt. Ltd. (CarToq.com)
Single-handedly scaled CarToq to 100M+ monthly page views and 15M+ unique visitors; owned full stack, infrastructure and ad-monetisation.
Implemented AMP across the site delivering measurable load-time and revenue lift.
Built an in-house push notification system delivering to 100K users per minute and integrated 30+ advertisers with header bidding, sustaining high QPS and Redis throughput (~750K reads/sec).
Software Engineer Doyen Labs
Delivered client websites and web applications across multiple stacks; owned scoping, development and client communication for custom projects.
